title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Trust in a big moment
hook: The game is close. Do you put your youngest player in?
intro: They have worked hard all season.
This is the biggest game so far.
statement: Trust given in a big moment is remembered for years.
q1: Do you give the young player the moment —
q2: or stick with experience when it counts?
q3: What will they remember from this game?
t1: Every team is different. But young players grow
t2: when they are trusted before they are ready.
cta: Coaches — who plays in big moments?
ctaLines: Everyone gets a turn. Experience first. It depends.
Trust them or play it safe?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
The game is close. Do you put your youngest player in?
They have worked hard all season. This is the biggest game so far.
Trust given in a big moment is remembered for years.
Trust the young player or go with experience. There is no single right way.
Who plays in big moments? Share your habit in the comments.
